newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian year to Sept productivity 4.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian year to Sept productivity 4.1 pct.

text.p: Australian labour productivity grew 4.1 percent in trend terms in the year to September, the Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) said on Wednesday.

Trend labour productivity growth, as measured by hours worked in the non-farm market sector, moderated to 0.8 percent in the September quarter, compared to 1.0 percent in the June quarter and 1.3 percent in the March quarter.
In the June quarter release, annual trend labour productivity was 4.7 percent.
The ABS measure of wages growth, average non-farm wages salaries and supplements per wage and salary earner, rose a seasonally adjusted 5.4 percent in the year to September.
The September quarter growth of 1.1 percent compared with growth of 1.2 percent in the June quarter.
